canonical_queue.binding_basis: The six rendered titles match TP C01-C06 exactly and do not match the TZ01 title sequence.

audit_policy.semantic_track: Check whether wording, numbers, visual data encodings and causal structure remain faithful to the source and card-specific constraints.
audit_policy.strict_render_track: Treat card.title, card.visible_text, allowed_visible_numbers and the exact-once citation as the complete visible render contract; scene descriptions authorise objects, not extra labels.
global_constraints_checked: no causal claim that exercise frequency reduced CRF
no generalisation from physical CFS to affective, cognitive or total CFS
no claim that the ECOG-PS sensitivity model remained statistically significant
no selection of a supposedly correct HF/LF subgroup size from conflicting source labels
no implication that frequency is independent of cumulative exercise volume

summary.interpretation: Five cards are source-aligned in meaning, while C03 reverses the observed discharge direction in its timeline. Every card also violates the canonical queue's exact visible-text contract.

cards.title: 運動越常參與，身體疲勞越低？
visible_text: 130名住院接受化療的淋巴瘤患者
觀察到的是運動參與頻率與出院身體CFS的負向關聯
相關而非因果；只有身體CFS在主要調整模型達顯著
標籤與框線表示內容功能；小標記表示證據狀態。
cards.main_visual_scene: 一位住院化療患者沿著一週運動日曆走向較低的身體疲勞量表，旁邊以小型回歸係數卡呈現調整後關聯；使用關聯線而非因果箭頭。

violations: Unlisted visible scene labels include 一週運動參與日曆、休息、出院時身體疲勞程度（CFS）、高、低 and 調整後關聯（主要模型）.
The weekday grid renders additional day characters beyond the authorised visible-text strings.

cards.title: 院內運動方案怎麼做？
visible_text: 有氧＋阻力：每日1次、每週6天
Borg 12–13；有氧10–20分鐘
實際參與頻率中位數71.4%；觀察期共1854次課程
這是院內建議方案，不是已驗證的最佳運動處方。
cards.main_visual_scene: 住院病房中的週曆、腳踏車與阻力訓練器材並列；用六個運動日格和頻率計量條表示建議方案與實際參與。

violations: The calendar adds 一週計畫, weekday labels and 建議：每日1次、每週6天, none of which is an exact listed visible_text item.
The once-daily and six-days-per-week content is duplicated between the calendar and authorised sentence.

cards.title: 原始差異，基線就存在
visible_text: 出院身體CFS：HF 1.0｜LF 4.0
化療開始前：HF 2.0｜LF 5.0
兩組在治療開始前就不是同一個疲勞起點
基線已存在差異；原始組間差不可當療效
cards.main_visual_scene: 兩條平行的疲勞量表軌跡，各自在基線和出院有清楚標記；強調兩條線起點不同，不畫治療造成下降的因果箭頭。
cards.targeted_audit: fail: the timeline positions discharge at 6 for HF and 7 for LF despite the authorised discharge values 1.0 and 4.0.
semantic_violations: The HF timeline encodes discharge at 6 rather than 1.0.
The LF timeline encodes discharge at 7 rather than 4.0.
Both trajectories visually rise from baseline even though the source reports lower discharge medians in both groups.
cards.required_correction: Place HF baseline at 2.0 and discharge at 1.0; place LF baseline at 5.0 and discharge at 4.0. Remove every unlisted scale number and label unless the queue is formally revised.

violations: The timelines render 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6 and 7 although only 1.0, 2.0, 4.0 and 5.0 are authorised.
Unlisted labels include 高頻運動（HF組）, 低頻運動（LF組）, 基線（治療開始前）, 出院時, 疲勞量表（CFS） and the scale-note sentence.

cards.title: 顯著只出現在身體疲勞
visible_text: 主模型：身體CFS p=0.04
加入ECOG-PS：B=-2.04；正文 p=0.055（表格 p=0.06）
相關而非因果；敏感度分析未達統計顯著

violations: Unlisted footer text: 研究對象：住院淋巴瘤患者接受化學治療（基線分析）.

cards.title: 缺課，也有系統因素
visible_text: 物理治療師不在場 20.0%
化療相關不良事件原因合計 29.8%
百分比分母是未執行運動的session／原因，不是患者比例。
cards.main_visual_scene: 病房運動課程被三類障礙打斷：空著的治療師位置、疲勞患者、化療不良事件；使用原因分布卡，不畫成患者盛行率。

violations: Scene decoration adds the unlisted sign 物理治療師 and the unlisted symptom labels 噁心、嘔吐、腹瀉、血球低下.

cards.title: 為什麼不能說是療效？
visible_text: 疲勞本身可能讓人少運動：可能有反向因果
頻率與總運動量無法分開
單中心、回溯性，且沒有出院後長期追蹤
相關而非因果；需要前瞻性研究與長期追蹤。
cards.main_visual_scene: 一個研究解讀煞車板，三個警示圖像依序為雙向箭頭代表反向因果、FITT量尺代表總運動量混雜、單一醫院與短時間軸代表外部效度和追蹤限制。
cards.targeted_audit: fail: an unlisted disclaimer sentence was added in the footer.
